cover_headline: India in Final-Stage Talks on Expanded BrahMos Missile Sale to Philippines

end.headline: India in Final-Stage Talks on Expanded BrahMos Missile Sale to Philippines
end.line: Final-stage talks, as reported, are not yet a deal — the next step to watch is a signed contract.

facts: The Philippines is expected to buy about five BrahMos systems — nearly 60 missiles — in a deal potentially worth $700 million to $800 million
The expected deal is roughly double the $375 million BrahMos order the Philippines placed in 2022 for naval use
India's defence exports for the fiscal year to March reached 384.24 billion rupees ($4.11 billion), a jump of more than 62%
